checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Water bottle main subject, fully visible
must.why: Bottle is centered and entirely in frame.
Uniform non-reflective black surface with soft highlights.
White marble with grey veins in the foreground; the bottle sits on it.
Diffused light, soft shadow to the right, no harsh glare.

faults.what: Marble covers only the bottom quarter. The wall behind is blank white, so the composition is plain.
The bottle has little detail and no label, so it looks like a generic mockup.

summary: A clean product shot of a matte black bottle on veined white marble with soft light; it meets the brief, and the only weakness is a plain composition with little marble showing.
